expert.concept: A detail question: the answer is the reason the passage itself gives, in the same sentence that names the hypothesis.

misconceptions.choice: it suggested that DNA occurred only in the nuclei of blood cells

misconceptions.choice: it held that DNA contained far fewer parts than the proteins it was compared with
misconceptions.pull: Leans on 2.4 (proteins had about twenty building blocks); that sentence says why proteins looked better, not what the hypothesis claimed.

misconceptions.choice: it showed that the proportions of the bases differed from species to species

misconceptions.choice: it proposed that the molecule was a single short chain rather than a long one
